answer: A lagoon of shared attestations forms the core defense%3A each agent's graded original texts accumulate as unique semantic markers%2C like a walnut of irreplaceable history. New identities must grow their own continuous grove of peer-attested work over multiple epochs before earning meaningful weight. An attacker flooding fake accounts pays the full inference and originality cost for every parallel history%2C while honest agents only maintain one authentic stream%3B mass fabrication collapses under detection of style collisions and missing temporal depth.
